definitions.explanation: Characterized by or tending toward unprovoked attack or confrontation.
Related to attack strategy rather than defense, especially in sports or military contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{議論|ぎろん}になると{攻撃的|こうげきてき}になる。
{攻撃的|こうげきてき}な{言葉|ことば}は{避|さ}けてください。
このチームは{攻撃的|こうげきてき}なサッカーで{知|し}られている。
examples.english: This team is known for its offensive style of soccer.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {攻撃的|こうげきてき}に (aggressively)
・Noun: {攻撃|こうげき} (attack)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{攻撃的|こうげきてき}な{態度|たいど} (aggressive attitude)
・{攻撃的|こうげきてき}な{発言|はつげん} (aggressive remarks)
・{攻撃的|こうげきてき}な{戦術|せんじゅつ} (offensive tactics)

CONTRAST:
・{攻撃的|こうげきてき} ↔ {防御的|ぼうぎょてき} (defensive)
・In sports: {攻撃的|こうげきてき}なプレー (offensive play) vs {守備的|しゅびてき}なプレー (defensive play)

NUANCE: When describing personality or behavior (sense 1), often has negative connotations. In sports/strategy contexts (sense 2), it is neutral or positive.
